title: Encoded Length of a List of Actions
statement: For every $k,n\in\mathbb N$ and every finite list of actions for a $k$-tape machine with states indexed by $\{0,\ldots,n\}$, the number of actions is at most the length of the concatenation of their binary encodings.
hypotheses_covered: a finite list of actions for a $k$-tape machine with states indexed by $\{0,\ldots,n\}$
